newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS units to close 21 Swiss retail branches.
newsitem.headline: CS units to close 21 Swiss retail branches.

text.p: Credit Suisse and Swiss Volksbank said they will close 21 small retail branches as of December 31, 1996.

The two banks are combining their domestic Swiss retail operations following a restructuring of parent CS Holding, announced in July. Starting in 1997, CS Holding will operate under four major divisions, and be renamed as Credit Suisse Group. The retail banking unit will be known as Credit Suisse.
The 57 employees of the branches will be given jobs elsewhere within Credit Suisse.
In addition, in the Swiss Canton of Aargau, Credit Suisse branches will become part of Neue Aargauer Bank, which is owned by Volksbank.

Individual and customer business of Bank Leu, which is owned by CS Holding, and a corresponding integration of its branch network, will be completed at the end of 1997, the banks said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
